tool_args.rationale: The slow-horizon observations establish a reversal from positive to negative and, together with the pilot, span the fast and slow timescales. Numerically fitting the authorized dual-exponential law is the next economical test; fresh confirmation will determine whether it meets tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The supplied observations have s_grad=0 and follow the stated linear-in-u dual-horizon candidate; the extra sink parameter is not identifiable from these rows.
The pilot and long-horizon reversal are consistent with the authorized adaptation mechanism, without evidence requiring a periodic mechanism.
The existing eight rows span both short and target horizons and can calibrate the four-parameter model; confirmation should test it before further measurement.
It does not resolve the mechanism or calibrate its horizon dependence.
